about-scanner.content:
🔒 Vulnerability scanner based on external analysis

Our tool performs intelligent site scanning, identifying risks that become visible not only to intruders, but also to search engines. This allows you to detect vulnerabilities even before they are exploited.

The scanner analyzes publicly available data about your resource — such as is accessible from the outside without authorization. This includes:

Open administrative panels

Indexed directories and hidden files

Vulnerable entry points (XSS, SQL injections)

Confidential data freely available

✅ What makes our approach better than traditional scanners

Unlike classic scanners that work only from inside the system or require access to a server, our tool:

Does not require installation on the client side

Analyzes the site as it is seen by an external user or bot

Identifies risks of information leakage and incorrect access settings

Helps protect against unauthorized indexing and digital intelligence

💡🔎 Why this is needed

Our approach helps companies find risks in time that may be visible to intruders from the outside. This is important to protect business, reputation, and customers. Such an audit allows you to:

Understand what is visible about the company on the Internet — what data, panels, and vulnerabilities are available without logging in

Close weaknesses before someone finds them — protect yourself before indexing by search engines or malicious actions

Strengthen cybersecurity — reduce the risk of leaks and external interference

Comply with regulatory requirements — help with audits and security standards compliance
